applies_why: This judge text does the RESULT determination by awarding DEFENDER WINS and relying on a standing whose stated broken-link reason was later retracted.
quote: STATEMENT: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 / CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1; JUDGE STATEMENT: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count — read as invalidating the standing because its stated reason (the C3 broken grade) was retracted, versus read as allowing the standing to count under CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1; the rule requires the first reading.
why: Because the retraction removes the only stated basis for treating CHALLENGE STANDING as not SELF-SUPPORTED and no un-retracted CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN collision remains, the DEFENDER WINS result does not meet the rule.
